search.snippet: The silk merchant in Ardougne square wears a purple beret, a nonexistent item. The pink gamer in the rat pits wears a pink beret, also a nonexistent item. The Gielinor Guide on Tutorial Island was the only NPC to wear a red beret until its release on 12 June 2014 with the Treasure Trail Expansion update, which made it available to players.

There's other variants: the white beret, blue beret and red beret. Black berets can be attached to a mime mask to make a beret mask by talking to Patchy on Mos Le'Harmless, along with 500 coins.

search.snippet: Shorts are sold in Keldagrim at Vermundi's Clothes Stall (brown) and Agmundi Quality Clothes (blue and yellow). The blue and yellow versions can also be bought at the Miscellanian Clothes Shop in Miscellania, although this requires partial completion of Royal Trouble. They are purely for decoration.
